name: tw-hooks
description: Shared guardrail hooks for all TechWave plugins — install alongside tw-ba/tw-dev/tw-qa. PreToolUse sensitive-data guard blocks reading or exfiltrating secret files (.env, private keys, cloud credentials, tfstate) so secrets never enter the conversation; PostToolUse compliance scan warns on hardcoded credentials, PII in log statements, and cloud access keys in written files.
